description: Free, no key needed. One Bosco Labs tool's full input schema, example input, example rows, output fields, price per row, caps and sources. Use it before calling a tool whose input you are unsure of: the tool list shortens each input field to one sentence, and this shows every field, its allowed values and a working example. Takes the tool name (eu_tenders, or its HTTP slug eu-tenders); an unknown name returns the closest names.
name: describe_official_records_tool
title: Describe an official-records tool
